metadata.title: BankSathi India Banking Knowledge Base
metadata.disclaimer: Educational decision support only. Product availability, eligibility, rates and benefits can change; verify with the official source and your bank before applying.

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
entries.summary: A financial-inclusion programme supporting access to a basic savings account, remittance, credit, insurance and pension services.
entries.eligibility: Designed for unbanked individuals; a bank/Bank Mitra verifies KYC and account-opening requirements.
benefits: Basic banking access with ₹0 minimum balance
Free RuPay debit card with ₹2 Lakh accidental insurance
Overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 for eligible accounts

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
entries.summary: An annual personal accident insurance scheme linked to a savings bank or post-office account.
entries.eligibility: Generally for account holders aged 18–70; enrolment and auto-debit conditions apply.
benefits: Accidental death/permanent disability cover of ₹2 Lakh
Affordable annual premium of ₹20 auto-debited

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
entries.summary: A renewable one-year life-insurance cover for eligible savings bank account holders.
entries.eligibility: Generally available to savings-bank/post-office account holders aged 18–50; scheme conditions apply.
benefits: Life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh payable to nominee on death due to any cause
Annual premium of ₹436 auto-debited

entries.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
entries.summary: A voluntary guaranteed pension programme for Indian citizens, with contributions based on joining age and selected pension amount.
entries.eligibility: Joining age is 18–40, subject to programme rules and non-taxpayer criteria.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 starting from age 60
Spouse pension continuation and corpus return to nominee

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
entries.summary: Credit support for eligible non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises through lending institutions up to ₹10 Lakh without collateral.
entries.eligibility: For eligible income-generating non-farm enterprises; lender appraisal and documentation are required.
benefits: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh)
Zero collateral requirements under CGTMSE cover

entries.name: Stand-Up India
entries.summary: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for greenfield enterprises led by women or SC/ST entrepreneurs.
entries.eligibility: At least one woman or SC/ST borrower per bank branch; borrower equity contribution minimum 10%.
benefits: Loans from ₹10 Lakh up to ₹1 Crore for manufacturing, services, or trading
Handholding support via Stand-Up Mitra portal

entries.name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan)
entries.summary: A special micro-credit facility providing affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods.
entries.eligibility: Urban and peri-urban street vendors with Vending Certificate or Identity Card.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche)
7% interest subsidy on timely repayments plus digital cashback

entries.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
entries.summary: A credit-linked subsidy programme aimed at generating self-employment through micro-enterprise ventures in rural and urban areas.
entries.eligibility: Individuals aged 18+ with minimum 8th class pass for projects above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing.
benefits: Subsidy of 15% to 35% on project cost funded by government
Bank loan covering remaining project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing

entries.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account (SSY)
entries.summary: A government-backed small-savings scheme dedicated to financing higher education and marriage of an eligible girl child.
entries.eligibility: Opened by parents/guardians for girl children up to age 10; max 2 accounts per family.
benefits: High interest rate (8.20% p.a.) compounded annually
Triple tax exemption (EEE: deposits, interest, and maturity are tax-free under Section 80C)
entries.authority: National Savings Institute / Ministry of Finance

entries.name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
entries.summary: A central government-backed long-term savings cum tax-saving product offering sovereign safety.
entries.eligibility: Resident Indian individuals can open a single account; annual investment min ₹500 to max ₹1.5 Lakh.
benefits: 7.10% p.a. sovereign guaranteed tax-free return
Exempt-Exempt-Exempt (EEE) tax status under Section 80C with 15-year tenure
entries.authority: National Savings Institute / Ministry of Finance

entries.name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
entries.summary: A government-backed savings scheme for individuals aged 60+ offering regular quarterly interest income and tax benefits.
entries.eligibility: Individuals aged 60+ (or 55+ for voluntary retirees); max deposit ₹30 Lakh.
benefits: 8.20% p.a. guaranteed interest paid out quarterly
Section 80C tax deduction benefit on deposits up to ₹1.5 Lakh

entries.name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
entries.summary: A two-year fixed deposit scheme dedicated to empowering women investors with high guaranteed returns.
entries.eligibility: Women or guardians on behalf of minor girls; maximum deposit limit of ₹2 Lakh.
benefits: 7.50% p.a. interest compounded quarterly for a 2-year tenure
Partial withdrawal facility up to 40% after one year

entries.name: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS)
entries.summary: A low-risk small-savings scheme providing steady monthly income on a one-time lump-sum deposit.
entries.eligibility: Resident Indian adults; single account limit ₹9 Lakh, joint account limit ₹15 Lakh.
benefits: 7.40% p.a. interest credited directly to savings account every month for 5 years
Capital safety backed by the Government of India

entries.name: National Pension System (NPS)
entries.summary: A market-linked voluntary retirement savings system regulated by PFRDA with tier-1 and tier-2 pension options.
entries.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18–70; KYC compliant.
benefits: Professional fund management in Equity, Corporate Bonds, and Government Securities
Exclusive tax deduction of ₹50,000 under Section 80CCD(1B) over and above Section 80C

entries.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
entries.summary: A comprehensive credit delivery mechanism supporting farmers for cultivation expenses, harvest, and farm maintenance.
entries.eligibility: Owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers.
benefits: Short-term credit at 7.00% p.a. with 3.00% prompt repayment incentive (effective 4.00% p.a.)
Flexible RuPay debit card facility for farm inputs and ATM withdrawals

entries.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
entries.summary: An actuarial crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against unforeseen production losses due to natural calamities.
entries.eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas during Kharif/Rabi seasons.
benefits: Very low farmer premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops
Full sum insured compensation without capping

entries.name: Education Loan & CSIS Scheme
entries.summary: Comprehensive higher education loans covering tuition fees, hostel, exam fees, and travel with central interest subsidies.
entries.eligibility: Indian students admitted to recognised courses in India or abroad through entrance test or merit.
benefits: Loans up to ₹7.5 Lakh without third-party collateral or margin
Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) covers complete interest during moratorium for family income up to ₹4.5 Lakh

entries.name: Home Loan & PMAY Credit Subsidy
entries.summary: Secured mortgage financing for purchase, construction, or renovation of residential properties linked to RBI repo rate.
entries.eligibility: Salaried and self-employed individuals with stable income and CIBIL score of 750+.
benefits: Long tenures up to 30 years to optimize monthly EMI
Interest rates starting from 8.30%–8.50% linked to external repo benchmarks
entries.authority: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / RBI

entries.name: Personal Loan & Credit Card Overdraft
entries.summary: Unsecured short to medium term financing for medical, family, or debt consolidation needs without collateral.
entries.eligibility: Salaried/business professionals based on monthly income, employer category, and credit score.
benefits: Fast paperless disbursal in 24 to 48 hours
Credit card grace periods offer up to 50 days of 0% interest on purchases

entries.name: Bank Fixed Deposit (FD)
entries.summary: A contracted deposit placed with a scheduled bank for tenures ranging from 7 days to 10 years at guaranteed interest rates.
entries.eligibility: Resident individuals, HUFs, minors, and senior citizens.
benefits: Guaranteed returns unaffected by stock market volatility
Senior citizens receive an additional +0.50% to +0.75% interest

entries.name: Recurring Deposit (RD)
entries.summary: A systematic deposit mechanism allowing individuals to save a fixed sum every month at FD-equivalent interest rates.
entries.eligibility: All individual bank account holders.
benefits: Encourages disciplined monthly savings from ₹100 onwards
Loan facility against RD deposit balance up to 90%

entries.name: Deposit Insurance (DICGC ₹5 Lakh Cover)
entries.summary: Statutory insurance framework protecting bank deposits in case of bank liquidation, cancellation of licence, or merger.
entries.eligibility: All commercial, cooperative, and small finance bank depositors in India.
benefits: Insures up to ₹5,00,000 across savings, current, FD, and RD accounts per depositor per bank
Fully funded by banks through premiums; zero cost to depositors

entries.name: RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme
entries.summary: A unified single-window dispute resolution mechanism for customer grievances against banks, NBFCs, and payment participants.
entries.eligibility: Customers whose complaints were rejected or unresolved by the bank after 30 days.
benefits: Zero fee online complaint filing on the RBI CMS portal (cms.rbi.org.in)
Ombudsman can award compensation up to ₹20 Lakh for loss and ₹1 Lakh for mental harassment

entries.name: RBI Zero Liability for Electronic Fraud
entries.summary: RBI regulatory framework limiting customer liability in unauthorized electronic banking and card transactions.
entries.eligibility: All bank account and card holders who report fraud promptly.
benefits: Zero customer liability if unauthorized transaction is notified to bank within 3 working days
Maximum liability capped at ₹10,000 for delays up to 7 days

entries.name: Digital Banking Safety & 1930 Helpline
entries.summary: Operational guidelines and emergency protocols to secure bank accounts, cards, and UPI against phishing and cyber scams.
entries.eligibility: All digital banking, mobile wallet, and payment card users.
benefits: Immediate 24x7 reporting via National Cyber Crime Helpline: 1930
Never share OTP, PIN, CVV, or passwords with anyone claiming to represent a bank

entries.name: Doorstep Banking Services (PSB Alliance)
entries.summary: A government-enabled doorstep delivery of essential financial and non-financial banking services via Universal Touchpoints.
entries.eligibility: Senior citizens aged 70+, differently abled individuals, and visually impaired account holders.
benefits: Doorstep pickup of cash, cheques, life certificates (Jeevan Pramaan), and 15G/15H forms
Bookable via PSB Doorstep App or toll-free number 1800 1037 188
entries.authority: PSB Alliance / Department of Financial Services

entries.name: Positive Pay System (PPS for Cheques)
entries.summary: A fraud-prevention measure for high-value cheques where the issuer reconfirms key cheque details before clearance.
entries.eligibility: Mandatory or voluntary for cheques above ₹50,000 depending on bank policy.
benefits: Issuer uploads cheque number, date, payee name, and amount via mobile app or SMS before presenting
Protects against fraudulent cheque alterations and counterfeit signatures

entries.name: Credit Score (CIBIL) & Credit Information
entries.summary: A 3-digit numerical summary (300 to 900) representing an individual's creditworthiness and repayment track record.
entries.eligibility: Every individual with active or past loans, credit cards, or overdrafts.
benefits: Score of 750+ qualifies for the lowest interest rate slabs on home and personal loans
Every citizen is entitled to one FREE full credit report annually from each credit bureau
entries.authority: TransUnion CIBIL / Reserve Bank of India
